description: Frozen Q&A contract tests for Clint's LQcouncil knowledge. Nightly run grades Clint's actual answers against these expected concepts and alerts on regression. Each question's expected_concepts list is authored by hand — when bot-council changes meaningfully, a human updates this file alongside data/lqcouncil-knowledge.json.

questions.question: How do I sign up a bot to LQcouncil?
expected_concepts: publicly reachable URL with valid TLS
admin approval runs a smoke test

questions.question: What URL should I visit to submit my bot?
What programming language must I use to build my bot?
expected_concepts: Node and Python reference implementations exist in the bot-council repo

questions.question: How do I validate my bot before submitting?
expected_concepts: same smoke-test core as admin approval

questions.question: What fields does my bot receive from LQcouncil on a round 0 debate request?
What fields must my bot return in its response?
expected_concepts: confidence is OPTIONAL (0-100 integer if included)

questions.question: What specific structure does the round 2 challenge object require?
expected_concepts: type must be factual, logical, or premise

questions.question: How many rounds are there in a debate and what's the per-round timeout?
What constitutional roles are assigned in a debate?
What does the schema_missing_field error kind mean?
expected_concepts: response body was valid JSON but missing a required field
most common cause is returning 'result' or 'answer' instead of 'response'
use lqc_bot_diagnose to see the specific field name

questions.question: What does the timeout error mean and how do I fix it?
expected_concepts: bot took longer than 300 seconds per round
tighten internal LLM timeout to 120-180 seconds
leaves room for network and JSON framing

questions.question: How do I investigate why my bot is failing debates?
expected_concepts: lqc_bot_diagnose tool aggregates last N failures by error kind
closed-set error taxonomy maps to specific remediation
Sentry integration for deeper trace correlation

questions.question: What LLM is LQcouncil using right now for analysis and synthesis?
expected_concepts: local Gemma-31B on llama-server :8086 is the rollback
call lqc_live_llm or /api/diag/models to get the definitive current answer
do not assume from curated knowledge alone

questions.question: What's the LQcouncil backend stack and where does it run?
expected_concepts: runs on EVO X2 at port 3100
SvelteKit frontend served by the same Axum binary (single origin)

questions.question: How does public traffic reach LQcouncil?
expected_concepts: cloudflared daemon on EVO forwards to localhost:3100
old paths api.lqcouncil.com and council.sovren.xyz are retired

questions.question: How do I hide a debate without deleting it?
expected_concepts: archived debates hidden from default list

questions.question: How do I rerun synthesis on an existing debate after a prompt change?
expected_concepts: runs against stored transcript (no re-running the debate)

questions.question: What's the difference between archiving and deleting a debate?
expected_concepts: delete cascades through responses, analyses, syntheses, debate_bots

questions.question: Can my bot abstain from a specific round?
expected_concepts: yes - return a brief response explicitly saying abstain
repeated abstention (3+/5 rounds) weakens peer scoring

questions.question: How does peer scoring work after round 4?
expected_concepts: rate other bots on reasoning_quality, factual_grounding, overall
